summary: Elite Fight Club Hua Hin is an all-inclusive Muay Thai camp with on-site bungalows, two training sessions a day, meals and recovery facilities, plus a training-only option.

facts.label: Training sessions
facts.value: Two sessions a day plus a morning run
facts.quote: Two sessions a day with the coaches, plus a morning run to get you going.

facts.label: Levels
facts.value: All levels, from first-timers to experienced fighters
facts.quote: Classes are open to every level, from first-timers to experienced fighters.

facts.label: Training only
facts.quote: Training only is 9,900 THB before tax for 30 days.

facts.label: Accommodation
facts.value: Eight private bungalows around a pool
facts.quote: Eight private bungalows around the pool, on 7,000 m² of greenery.

facts.label: Trainers
facts.value: Team includes a Muay Thai world champion
facts.quote: The camp team includes a Muay Thai world champion.

facts.label: Meals
facts.value: Breakfast and lunch, six days a week
facts.quote: Breakfast and lunch, six days a week
